responses.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) AS per_driver

assumptions.assumption: laps is stored as TEXT, so it is cast to REAL before averaging; NULL values are ignored by SUM and AVG. Drivers are grouped by driverId, and every driver with at least one qualifying result (grid >= 12) is included, even if their points or laps are all NULL (such drivers drop out of the respective outer average).

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN laps GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) t

assumptions.assumption: Missing laps values (NULL or non-numeric text such as an empty string) are excluded from each driver's laps average. Drivers whose laps are all missing are skipped in the outer laps average, while still counting in the outer points average.
grid >= 12 is applied literally, so rows with grid = 0 (pit-lane starts) are excluded.

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId)

assumptions.assumption: Grid values of 0 (pit-lane starts) are not treated specially, and only rows with grid >= 12 are included, so they are excluded by the filter.
laps is stored as TEXT, so it is cast to REAL before averaging. NULL values are ignored by AVG and SUM. A driver whose points are all NULL gets a NULL total, which the outer AVG skips.
Drivers are grouped by driverId, and only drivers with at least one qualifying result row are included.
